text:
viv (PM): quick pre-GA tidy: we need a short "must-have" checklist for compliance & field ops: SLA commitments, monitoring + sampling, support playbooks, pricing contingencies, and rollback rules.
cho (SRE): propose SLOs p95 <=150ms, p99 <=400ms, availability >=99.95%. include error-budget exhaustion flow: degrade to quantized model + surface customer notice.
amal (ProdOps): will schedule a 60m failover test (reserved-pool preempt + region spill) tomorrow 07:30 PT. need synthetic runner with mixed seq lengths.
jon (FinOps): pricing fallback options for pilots: (1) burst credit pool with surcharge, (2) throttled plan with discounted baseline. will draft simple examples and one-liner billing text.
irene (Docs): I can craft a one-page GA pack (customer + internal). need exact sample payload sizes and a short severity matrix for customer comms.
tara (Support): support needs: incident playbooks (latency, quality regression, billing), canned customer emails, and an escalation map. assigning owners: quality->research, infra->sre, billing->finops.
ops-bot: Deploy: prod-serving/v1.9 rolled out 2024-07-10T14:01Z.
viv (PM): action items: SRE alerts + synthetic (cho) - EOD; ProdOps failover artifacts (amal) - tomorrow AM; Docs one-pager (irene) - EOD; FinOps pricing bullets (jon) - EOD; Support dry-run (tara) - next week. include rollback criteria and SLA exception process in docs.
cho (SRE): I'll add alerts: p95>150ms for 5m, p99>400ms for 5m, burn_rate>2 for 1h, plus nightly synthetic for 72h.
amal (ProdOps): will attach run artifacts and a short reproduce guide so oncall can rerun.
jon (FinOps): uploading two small scenarios and a sample invoice blurb. recommending auto-throttle at sustained >3x baseline for 15m unless burst credits enabled.
irene (Docs): opening PRs: /docs/ga/customer-onepager.md and /docs/ga/internal-checklist.md with templates for exception emails.
tara (Support): scheduling a 30m dry-run with oncall; will circulate invite and test canned comms.
viv (PM): thanks all. we'll reconvene 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
